Command.Statement: SELECT NON EMPTY CrossJoin(Hierarchize(DrilldownMember({{DrilldownLevel({[ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[All Diagnoses by ICD-10 Chapter]},,,INCLUDE_CALC_MEMBERS)}}, {[ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[DIAGNOSES]},,,INCLUDE_CALC_MEMBERS)), Hierarchize({DrilldownLevel({[ZCLVTYPE].[All Visit Type]},,,INCLUDE_CALC_MEMBERS)})) DIMENSION PROPERTIES PARENT_UNIQUE_NAME ON COLUMNS FROM (SELECT ({[ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[DIAGNOSES].[RESPIRATORY].[UPPER_RESPIRATORY_INFECTIONS], [ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[DIAGNOSES].[RESPIRATORY].[INFLUENZA], [ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[DIAGNOSES].[RESPIRATORY].[LOWER_RESPIRATORY_DISEASES].[J20]}) ON COLUMNS FROM [ZCLVISIT]) WHERE ([Measures].[ZCLVISNO]) CELL PROPERTIES VALUE
